evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible permission, behavior, constraint, state, or rule with creating a game by entering a name/description.
Inviting estimators via a URL does not conflict with other stories' permissions or constraints.
Starting a round by entering an item in a text field does not impose rules incompatible with other stories.
Seeing all items for the session is not incompatible with other stories.
Selecting an item to be estimated or re-estimated does not conflict with other behaviors or constraints.
Adding an item to the list is compatible with other stories.
Editing an item is not inconsistent with other requirements.
Deleting an item from the list does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: PP-009: "As a moderator, I want to show all estimates immediately..."
evaluations.rationale: This grants the moderator the ability to reveal estimates before all estimators have given their estimates, which is incompatible with PP-033 that requires estimates to be shown only at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate.
Accepting the average of all estimates does not impose a constraint incompatible with other stories.
Auto-filling the estimate field when all estimators show the same card is a behavior compatible with other stories (it assumes all estimates have been shown/are identical).
Entering the agreed-upon estimate does not conflict with other permissions or constraints.
Re-estimating a previously estimated story is not inconsistent with other stories.
Importing stories from a spreadsheet is compatible with other backlog items.
Copy/pasting stories is not incompatible with other requirements.
Browsing previous games is not inconsistent with other stories (deletion stories may remove games but do not contradict the ability to browse existing games).
Viewing a transcript of a game is compatible with other stories; no incompatible constraints found.
Exporting a transcript as HTML does not conflict with other requirements.
Exporting a transcript as CSV is compatible with the rest of the backlog.
Deleting a game (removing its stories/estimates) does not impose rules incompatible with other stories; it coexists with browsing/deleting capabilities.
Creating an account with name/email/username does not conflict with other stories (research storage constraints are about aggregated results, not account creation).
Logging in using account name and password is consistent with account creation and other stories.
Changing account details does not conflict with other requirements.
Deleting an account and its games is not inconsistent with other stories; it specifies an allowed action with expected consequences.
Showing dates/times in local timezone does not impose incompatible constraints with other stories.
Providing a password reminder by email is compatible with account-related stories.
Allowing the moderator to select card sets (Fibonacci or powers of 2) imposes no incompatibility with other behaviors.
Limiting invitations to up to 15 estimators does not conflict with any other story specifying a different limit.
Joining a game by entering name on the provided URL is compatible with invitation and joining stories.
Seeing the item being estimated imposes no constraints incompatible with other stories.
Seeing all items to be estimated this session aligns with other item-list stories and is not conflicting.
Seeing immediately that an estimate has been given (presence indicator) does not conflict with the requirement to reveal values only after all are given.

evaluations.evidence: PP-033: "As a participant, I want to be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate..."
evaluations.rationale: This requires estimates to be revealed only after all estimators have given them, which is incompatible with PP-009 that allows the moderator to show estimates immediately before all have given.
Allowing participants to change their estimate up until the last person selects a card is compatible with other stories (timing and reveal rules do not directly contradict this permission).
Viewing each estimator's prior estimates for the story is not incompatible with other requirements (it concerns prior rounds/history).
Seeing who gave what estimates during the current round does not by itself mandate timing of reveal and so does not conflict with other stories' constraints.
Starting a visible two-minute countdown for all participants is not incompatible with other stories.
Resetting the two-minute timer when all have played an estimate is a behavior compatible with other timer and reveal stories.
Scrolling back through prior rounds' stories and estimates does not conflict with other requirements.
Maintaining card order across draws is not incompatible with other stories.
Allowing change of estimate until a draw is completed aligns with other stories about draw completion and does not conflict.
Displaying a thumbnail photo near played cards is a UI feature that does not impose rules conflicting with others.
Compliance with XHTML/CSS standards is not contradictory with other backlog items.
Having a list of definitions is consistent with other stories and imposes no incompatible constraints.
Creating database indexes for performance does not conflict with functional requirements in the backlog.
Supporting specified browsers is not incompatible with other requirements.
Complying with W3C accessibility guidelines where possible does not conflict with other stories.
Performance/responsiveness requirements do not impose constraints incompatible with other backlog items.
Unicode support is compatible with other requirements.
Sensible and predictable URLs do not conflict with other items.
Having nice error pages imposes no incompatible constraints with other stories.

Storing results in a non-identifiable way for research is a storage-policy requirement that does not directly contradict other functional stories (account creation, in-app identity display, and live UI can coexist with anonymized research storage).
Seeing metrics on use of the game is compatible with other backlog items and does not impose conflicting rules.
